text:
alex: Heads-up — our staging telemetry scan flagged a partner CI secret embedded in uploaded build logs. It looks like a KMS-wrapped blob but still counts as exposed. Found by log-scan. @sophia can you confirm blast radius?

sophia: saw it. one ciphertext found in vendor logs, key id projects/partner-kms/locations/global/keyR123. Only used by partner-integration svcacc in staging. No signs of downstream exfil beyond vendor logs. :thinking_face:

ravi: tagging sec oncall @nora. We should run a small containment + rotation: 1) disable the svcacc keys, 2) rewrap the ciphertext with a new wrapping key, 3) update Vault transit mapping if used, 4) turn on object-level audit and retention on the vendor bucket. Who takes step 1?

nora: I'll take step 1, starting now. Locking the SA and adding temporary deny bindings in IAM.

alex: thanks. @sophia can you rewrap and produce new ciphertext, include commands you run in the ticket?

sophia: yep. command I plan to run: 
```
# example rewrap path (Vault or gcloud depending on origin)
vault write transit/rewrap ciphertext=<OLD_CIPHERTEXT> key=new-wrap-key-id
# or via gcloud KMS -> decrypt/encrypt chain if needed:
gcloud kms decrypt --ciphertext-file=old.bin --location=global --keyring=kr --key=oldkey --plaintext-file=- | gcloud kms encrypt --location=global --keyring=kr --key=newkey --plaintext-file=- --ciphertext-file=new.bin
```
Will push new ciphertext to secure-bucket/tmp and drop exact commands/nonce in the incident ticket.

ravi: after rewrap we must update the Vault transit alias and the RBAC on the partner KMS key. Also enable object ACL logging for that S3 bucket and set retention to 90d.

alex: compliance needs audit evidence. Snapshot every step in INC-2026-410. Keep old ciphertext archived (marked revoked) — don't delete until legal ok.

nora: SA disabled and deny-binding added (iam). I put my notes in the ticket. ts:7532100006

sophia: rewrap done. New ciphertext uploaded to secure-bucket/tmp/7532100007.enc. I validated decrypt locally against new key. Pasted rewrap command + nonce in the ticket.

ravi: I'm updating Vault mapping to transit/new-wrap-key and rolling the sidecar that fetches wrapping keys. I'll open a small infra PR for the alias switch.

alex: PR posted: infra#3421. Doing a canary to 3 pods then full rollout if no decryption errors in 10m.

sophia: canary looks clean, no decryption errors observed. :thumbsup:

ravi: RBAC cleaned: removed old key grants, created IAM condition to restrict access to vault-worker role only. Enabled bucket object access logs and set retention to 90d.

alex: partnerships needs to rotate the partner-side CI secret as well and get confirmation from vendor. @jamal can you coordinate?

jamal: pinged vendor, they rotated the credential and provided a signed receipt. Uploaded to INC-2026-410.

ravi: remaining follow-ups: add runbook entry for KMS key lifecycle changes, create detection rule for KMS-wrapped ciphertext in logs (regex for patterns like 'vault:v1:' or 'gcp-kms-v1:'), and add a pre-ingest hook to block uploads containing those patterns.

nora: adding RBAC-hardening and log-scrub tasks to the security sprint board. ETA: next week.

alex: great work. Closing thread unless someone sees leftover issues. :celebrate:

secrets-bot: Incident INC-2026-410 status -> mitigated. Audit bundle uploaded to evidence-bucket/INC-2026-410/.

sophia: noted. I'll draft the postmortem and link the evidence to Confluence.
